name: ultra-realistic-luxury-skincare-ad
image_vibe: Glossy futuristic pastel-pink beauty campaign with bold red tailoring and turquoise product contrast
image_purpose: Create a premium skincare advertisement and product-focused campaign visual.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic cinematic skincare advertisement inside a glossy pastel-pink futuristic room, built around a large turquoise moisturizer tube and a confident adult fashion model.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult fashion model in a bold red tailored suit, matching red heels, and black sunglasses, leaning forward with one hand reaching toward the camera in a powerful pose. Keep the model's identity original and subordinate to the product hero.
prompt.composition_elements: Giant turquoise skincare tube in the foreground dominating the composition, exact label text 'GARNIER SKINCARE Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer' on the tube, two smaller identical tubes symmetrically in the background, model behind the product, reflective pink-and-burgundy checkerboard floor, curved pastel-pink room, and wide-angle low-camera perspective.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused ceiling lighting with glossy reflections, vibrant red-to-teal color contrast, polished luxury beauty campaign atmosphere, controlled highlights on the product packaging, sunglasses, floor, and curved walls.
prompt.technical_specs: Wide-angle low camera, dramatic depth, sharp product focus with model and environment supporting the hierarchy, photorealistic commercial photography, high-resolution 8K-style texture, accurate tube and label rendering, no extra text or watermark beyond the specified product label.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic skincare advertisement inside a glossy pastel pink futuristic room with curved walls and soft diffused ceiling lighting. Show an original adult fashion model wearing a bold red tailored suit, matching red heels, and black sunglasses, leaning forward with one hand reaching toward the camera in a powerful pose. In the foreground place a giant turquoise skincare tube labeled 'GARNIER SKINCARE Ceramides & Hyaluronic Barrier Repair Moisturizer' dominating the composition. Place two smaller identical product tubes symmetrically in the background. Use a reflective pink and burgundy checkerboard floor, wide-angle perspective, low camera angle, dramatic depth, glossy reflections, vibrant contrast between the red outfit and teal product, luxury beauty campaign aesthetic, polished fashion-editorial lighting, sharp focus, accurate product-label rendering, ultra-detailed photorealistic 8K-style commercial photography, and no extra text or watermark beyond the specified label.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, distorted product tube, misspelled product label, invented logos, extra products, duplicate model, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, watermark

assets.name: source turquoise Garnier moisturizer product
assets.usage: Preserve the turquoise tube, product identity, specified label text, scale hierarchy, and duplicate background placement; do not invent a different product or logo.

assets.name: source pink futuristic skincare campaign scene
assets.usage: Use optional guidance for the curved pink room, red-suited model, checkerboard floor, low angle, and glossy beauty-campaign treatment.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the product reference when exact packaging and label fidelity are required. Keep the specified product label, turquoise color, foreground hero scale, two background duplicates, red suit, pink room, and low-angle commercial hierarchy. Model identity may vary.
